description: Accessibility snapshot of the current page: roles, names and [ref=…] for interactive elements, including elements inside closed shadow DOM and cross-origin iframes. Refs are stable: an element keeps its ref while the page (document) stays the same. Set interactiveOnly for a short list of what can be clicked/typed, or diff to get only what changed since the last snapshot of this tab (cheap after small updates). To look up a few elements on a big page, prefer find.

diff.description: Only lines added/removed since the last snapshot of this tab.

name: snapshot
